blocks.text: NEW YORK — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 22 points and a career-high 23 rebounds, Bam Adebayo scored 25 points and the Miami Heat ended the New York Knicks’ six-game winning streak and NBA Cup title reign with a 108-105 victory Friday night. The Knicks erased a 23-point deficit to grab the lead in the fourth quarter, but Jalen Brunson hit only two of three free throws when he was fouled shooting a 3-pointer with 9.8 seconds remaining and the Heat held on. Miami would have won its group and advanced to the quarterfinals if Philadelphia had lost in Indiana, but the 76ers […]...
